title: Find K-th Smallest Pair Distance
statement:
Given an array A of N integers, find the K-th smallest distance among all pairs (A[i], A[j]) where i < j. The distance is defined as |A[i] - A[j]|.

Sort the array first. Then binary search the distance in [0, max(A) - min(A)]. For a given distance D, use a sliding window (or two pointers) to efficiently count how many pairs have distance <= D.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and K.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the K-th smallest pair distance.
